meta.dataset_note: The 44 bechina edges in torahData.js with reference===2 all belong to LM1 Torah 2 content (prayer/Mishkan/Mashiach/Brit). The actual LM2 Torah 2 text (Chanukah/Hodayah/Halakhot/Dibur/Shabbat/Emet) has not yet been entered into torahData.js. All additions below are drawn entirely from the LM2 Torah 2 source text and represent the complete set of concepts that need to be entered.

additions.reason: Thanksgiving/acknowledgment — the defining quality of Chanukah days and the dominant node of the entire LM2 Torah 2. It is explicitly called a bechina of שעשוע עולם הבא.
additions.source_quote: וִימֵי הוֹדָאָה זֶה בְּחִינַת שַׁעֲשׁוּעַ עוֹלָם הַבָּא

additions.reason: The delight/pleasure of the World to Come — the highest good. It is the essential nature shared by הודאה, הלכות, and דעת. It is the dominant hub linking the entire chain of equivalences in this Torah.
additions.source_quote: זֶה עִקָּר שַׁעֲשׁוּעַ עוֹלָם הַבָּא – לְהוֹדוֹת וּלְהַלֵּל

additions.reason: The thanksgiving-offering — called a bechina of הלכות and of שעשוע עולם הבא. The word תודה is also the letters of תולדה (birth), linking the halachah/thanksgiving cluster to the birth/blood cluster.
additions.source_quote: וּבְחִינַת תּוֹדָה, שֶׁהוּא שַׁעֲשׁוּעַ עוֹלָם הַבָּא, זֶה בְּחִינַת הֲלָכוֹת

additions.reason: Halachot (Jewish law/legal rulings) — the most central concept of the entire LM2 Torah 2. Called bechina of תודה, שעשוע עולם הבא, חסדי ה', חסד, תולדה, and תהלוכות הדמים. The dominant node of the new Halakhah package.
additions.source_quote: וּבְחִינַת תּוֹדָה, שֶׁהוּא שַׁעֲשׁוּעַ עוֹלָם הַבָּא, זֶה בְּחִינַת הֲלָכוֹת

additions.reason: The kindnesses of God — explicitly called a bechina of הלכות. The verse 'מִי חָכָם וְיִשְׁמָר אֵלֶּה וְיִתְבּוֹנְנוּ חַסְדֵּי ה'' ties חסד, הלכות, and wisdom together.
additions.source_quote: חַסְדֵּי ה' זֶה בְּחִינַת הֲלָכוֹת

additions.reason: Serving Torah scholars — called a bechina of הלכות. Connecting the student-teacher relationship (שמוש) to the legal tradition (הלכות).
additions.source_quote: וְשִׁמּוּשׁ חֲכָמִים זֶה בְּחִינַת הֲלָכוֹת

additions.reason: The orderly flow/circulation of the blood — called a bechina of הלכה. The word הלכה derives etymologically from הליכה (walking/going), equated here with the proper flow of blood through the body's paths.
additions.source_quote: הַתּוֹדָה... הִיא מְכֻנָּה בְּשֵׁם הֲלָכָה, עַל שֵׁם תַּהֲלוּכוֹת הַדָּמִים

additions.reason: Birth/childbirth — explicitly called a bechina of הלכה. When the blood returns to its proper pathways (תהלוכות הדמים), birth follows. The connection is also linguistic: תודה = letters of תולדה.
additions.source_quote: כִּי גַּם הַהֲלָכָה הִיא בְּחִינַת הוֹלָדָה

additions.reason: The moon — called a bechina of חסרון (deficiency) in its natural cold state, but destined for future fullness (מלוי החסרון). Used as a structural metaphor for the process of spiritual deficiency being filled through halachot/chesed.
additions.source_quote: כִּי הַלְּבָנָה טִבְעָהּ קַר, בְּחִינַת חִסָּרוֹן וּקְרִירוּת

additions.reason: Deficiency/lack — the nature of the moon (לבנה) and of those who give money to support Torah scholars (temporarily depleted). Its counterpart is מלוי החסרון (filling the lack) through halachot/chesed.
additions.source_quote: כִּי הַלְּבָנָה טִבְעָהּ קַר, בְּחִינַת חִסָּרוֹן וּקְרִירוּת, וַעֲתִידָה לְהִתְמַלֹּאת

additions.reason: Filling the deficiency — the positive outcome of supporting Torah scholars (הלכות/chesed). The moon's future fullness (כְּאוֹר הַחַמָּה) is called a bechina of מלוי החסרון and of הולדה.
additions.source_quote: וַעֲתִידָה לְהִתְמַלֹּאת כְּאוֹר הַחַמָּה, בְּחִינַת מִלּוּי הַחִסָּרוֹן, שֶׁזֶּה בְּחִינַת הוֹלָדָה, בְּחִינַת הֲלָכוֹת

additions.reason: Truth — the illuminating force that completes speech (דבור). It is the common thread linking all three divine names (אל = תפלה = אמת, אלקים = תורה = אמת, ה' = שידוכים = אמת). The dominant node of the Speech/Truth package.
additions.source_quote: וּשְׁלֵמוּת הַדִּבּוּר הוּא עַל יְדֵי הָאֱמֶת... עִקָּר שְׁלֵמוּת הַדִּבּוּר – עַל יְדֵי אֱמֶת

additions.reason: Speech — the central faculty illuminated by truth (אמת). Has four dimensions (ריבוע הדבור). Completed through the three divine names. The 'species-defining quality' of the human being (יתרון האדם על החי).
additions.source_quote: עִקָּר שְׁלֵמוּת הַדִּבּוּר – עַל יְדֵי אֱמֶת

additions.reason: The fourfold speech / four dimensions of speech — the complete structure of spiritual speech. Each dimension corresponds to one of the four divine objects used by Rabbi Eliezer to demonstrate his mastery (חרוב, אמת המים, כתלי בית המדרש, בת קול).
additions.source_quote: בְּרִבּוּעַ הַדִּבּוּר, הַיְנוּ בְּחִינַת אַרְבָּעָה חֶלְקֵי הַדִּבּוּר

additions.reason: The speech of charity — the first dimension of the fourfold speech. The defining quality of the human being (גדר האדם). Corresponds to 'לֹא אִישׁ דְּבָרִים אָנֹכִי' and to חרוב (carob) in Rabbi Eliezer's demonstration.
additions.source_quote: יֵשׁ דִּבּוּר שֶׁל צְדָקָה, בִּבְחִינַת: מְדַבֵּר בִּצְדָקָה

additions.reason: The speech of repentance — the second dimension of the fourfold speech. Corresponds to 'גַּם מִתְּמוֹל' and to אמת המים (water channel) in Rabbi Eliezer's demonstration.
additions.source_quote: יֵשׁ דִּבּוּר שֶׁל תְּשׁוּבָה, בְּחִינַת: קְחוּ עִמָּכֶם דְּבָרִים וְשׁוּבוּ אֶל ה'

additions.reason: The speech of wealth — the third dimension of the fourfold speech. The rich who are close to kingship have a special quality of speech (חן שפתיו). Corresponds to 'גַּם מִשִּׁלְשֹׁם' and to כתלי בית המדרש (walls of the study hall) in Rabbi Eliezer's demonstration.
additions.source_quote: יֵשׁ דִּבּוּר שֶׁל עֲשִׁירוּת, דְּהַיְנוּ עֲשִׁירִים קְרוֹבִים לַמַּלְכוּת

additions.reason: The speech of kingship / royal speech — the fourth dimension of the fourfold speech. Called 'מלכות פה'. Corresponds to 'גַּם מֵאָז דַּבֶּרְךָ' and to בת קול (divine voice) in Rabbi Eliezer's demonstration.
additions.source_quote: יֵשׁ דִּבּוּר שֶׁל מַלְכוּת, בְּחִינַת מַלְכוּת פֶּה

additions.reason: Kingship of the mouth — the fourth dimension of speech, corresponding to בת קול. The voice that issues from the 'six rings of the windpipe' (שית עזקאין דקנה).
additions.source_quote: יֵשׁ דִּבּוּר שֶׁל מַלְכוּת, בְּחִינַת מַלְכוּת פֶּה

additions.reason: The Holy Language (Hebrew) — called a bechina of שלמות הדבור (complete speech). It is connected to Shabbat (שבת), from which blessing and holiness flow. Drawing the Shabbat joy into the six weekdays is accomplished through the vehicle of לשון הקדש.
additions.source_quote: שְׁלֵמוּת הַדִּבּוּר הוּא בְּחִינַת לְשׁוֹן הַקֹּדֶשׁ

additions.reason: The carob tree — explicitly called a bechina of צדקה (charity), the first of the four dimensions of speech. Planted only for future generations, like tzedakah which cycles through the world.
additions.source_quote: חָרוּב יוֹכִיחַ – זֶה בְּחִינַת הַדִּבּוּר שֶׁל צְדָקָה, כִּי חָרוּב הוּא בְּחִינַת צְדָקָה

additions.reason: The water channel — called a bechina of תשובה (repentance), the second of the four dimensions of speech.
additions.source_quote: אַמַּת הַמַּיִם – זֶה בְּחִינַת תְּשׁוּבָה

additions.reason: The walls of the study hall — called a bechina of עשירים (the wealthy), the third of the four dimensions of speech. The wealthy serve as the 'walls' that everyone turns to, but their sustenance flows from the study hall.
additions.source_quote: כָּתְלֵי בֵּית הַמִּדְרָשׁ – זֶה בְּחִינַת עֲשִׁירִים, שֶׁהֵם כְּתֵל שֶׁהַכֹּל פּוֹנִין בּוֹ

additions.reason: The divine voice (echo/heavenly announcement) — called a bechina of מלכות, the fourth of the four dimensions of speech. The voice that issues from the six rings of the windpipe.
additions.source_quote: בַּת קוֹל – זֶה בְּחִינַת מַלְכוּת

additions.reason: The three divine names (El, Elohim, YHVH) — they are the source of truth (מקור האמת) that illuminates the fourfold speech. אל = תפלה, אלקים = תורה, ה' = שידוכים. Together they complete the speech through truth.
additions.source_quote: שְׁלֹשָׁה שֵׁמוֹת הַנַּ"ל שֶׁהֵם: אֵל אֱלֹקִים ה', שֶׁהֵם בְּחִינַת: תְּפִלָּה וְתוֹרָה וְשִׁדּוּכִים

additions.reason: Matchmaking / marriage — called a bechina of the divine name ה' (YHVH), and a bechina of אמת. Marriage brings together the two halves of speech (women hold nine of the ten measures of conversation), completing the fourfold speech.
additions.source_quote: ה' זֶה בְּחִינַת שִׁדּוּכִים... וְהוּא בְּחִינַת אֱמֶת, בִּבְחִינַת: אֲשֶׁר הִנְחַנִי בְּדֶרֶךְ אֱמֶת

additions.reason: Shabbat — called a bechina of בן (son), of נח (rest), and of אחדות הפשוט (simple divine unity). It is the vehicle through which Shabbat joy is drawn into the six weekdays. Connected to לשון הקדש.
additions.source_quote: שַׁבָּת הוּא בְּחִינַת בֵּן, וְאָז נַיְחָא לְעִלָּאִין וְתַתָּאִין

additions.reason: The joy of Shabbat — the positive spiritual content that is drawn down into the six weekdays through לשון הקדש. The antidote to the sadness/עצבות of the weekdays. Equivalent to the numerical value of 'אל אלקים ה' דבר' (with the words) = שמחה.
additions.source_quote: עַל יְדֵי שְׁלֵמוּת הַדִּבּוּר, שֶׁהוּא לְשׁוֹן הַקֹּדֶשׁ, נִמְשָׁךְ שִׂמְחָה

additions.reason: Simple/absolute divine unity — revealed through Shabbat. When the varied activities of the six weekdays are subsumed into Shabbat rest, the simple unity underlying all diversity is revealed. The principle 'יחיד ורבים הלכה כרבים' is itself a reflection of this — diverse individual opinions converging into one.
additions.source_quote: עַל יְדֵי שַׁבָּת נִתְגַלֶּה אַחְדוּת הַפָּשׁוּט יִתְבָּרַךְ

additions.reason: Metatron (the angel who rules the weekdays) — called a bechina of עבד (servant) and of עצבות (sadness). He is the neutral/lower angelic force that governs the six days of the week, in contrast to the Shabbat/Son principle.
additions.source_quote: כִּי מְטַ"ט שָׁלְטְנוּתֵהּ בִּימֵי הַחֹל, וּמְטַ"ט הוּא בְּחִינַת עֶבֶד, בְּחִינַת עַצְבוּת

additions.reason: Sadness/depression — the defining quality of the six weekdays under Metatron's rule. Even the mitzvot of the weekdays carry this quality of sadness. The antithesis of the Shabbat joy.
additions.source_quote: יְמֵי הַחֹל הֵם בְּחִינַת עַצְבוּת... מְטַ"ט הוּא בְּחִינַת עֶבֶד, בְּחִינַת עַצְבוּת

additions.reason: Servant — the quality of Metatron and the six weekdays, in contrast to בן (son) = Shabbat. The distinction servant/son is the axis of the Shabbat package.
additions.source_quote: מְטַ"ט הוּא בְּחִינַת עֶבֶד... שַׁבָּת הוּא בְּחִינַת בֵּן

additions.reason: Son — the quality of Shabbat, as opposed to עבד (servant) = weekdays/Metatron. The Shabbat is called a 'son' because it brings rest and joy to all existence (נח = נַיְחָא דְּעִלָּאִין וְתַתָּאִין).
additions.source_quote: שַׁבָּת הוּא בְּחִינַת בֵּן

additions.reason: Oil — the Chanukah oil is called a bechina of אור האמת (the light of truth). It is also healing for the lungs (רפואה לרֵאָה). Connects the physical Chanukah symbol to the spiritual concept of truth illuminating speech.
additions.source_quote: הַשֶּׁמֶן, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת אוֹר הָאֱמֶת, בְּחִינַת: שְׁלַח אוֹרְךָ וַאֲמִתֶּךָ

additions.reason: The light of truth — the essential nature of the Chanukah oil (שמן). It is revealed through halachot/chesed (תמיך ואוריך לאיש חסידך), and it illuminates the dimension of speech (דבור).
additions.source_quote: זֶה בְּחִינַת הַשֶּׁמֶן, שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת אוֹר הָאֱמֶת

additions.reason: The Chanukah lamp — must be placed near the doorway ('סָמוּךְ לַפֶּתַח'), which is called a bechina of 'פִּתְחֵי פִיךָ' — the opening of the mouth. This connects the physical placement of the Chanukah light to speech/דבור.
additions.source_quote: וְצָרִיךְ לִתְּנוֹ סָמוּךְ לַפֶּתַח, בְּחִינַת: פִּתְחֵי פִיךָ, הַיְנוּ הַדִּבּוּר

additions.reason: Chanukah — parsed as 'חָנוּ כ"ה' (they rested on the 25th), which equals a bechina of שבת (Nayyacha). The Chanukah days are simultaneously הודאה, שעשוע עולם הבא, and the vehicle for drawing Shabbat holiness into the weekdays (=Chanukah).
additions.source_quote: חֲנֻכָּה – חָנוּ כ"ה, בְּחִינַת שַׁבָּת, נַיְחָא

additions.reason: Enoch — identified as the patriarch who was transformed into Metatron (מטט). Chanukah's name 'חנוכה' contains 'חנוך' as the weekday dimension, while 'כה' (=25) is the Shabbat dimension. The name synthesizes both poles.
additions.source_quote: שֵׁשֶׁת יְמֵי הַחֹל שֶׁהֵם גַּם כֵּן בְּחִינַת חֲנֻכָּה, בְּחִינַת חֲנוֹךְ, מְטַ"ט, עֶבֶד

additions.reason: Knowledge/intimate knowing of God — called the essential content of שעשוע עולם הבא. The verse 'כִּי מָלְאָה הָאָרֶץ דֵּעָה אֶת ה'' describes the World to Come state.
additions.source_quote: וְהַדַּעַת הוּא עִקָּר שַׁעֲשׁוּעַ עוֹלָם הַבָּא

additions.reason: The completeness/perfection of speech — achieved through אמת. It is a bechina of לשון הקדש. This is the goal state of the דבור/אמת package.
additions.source_quote: עִקָּר שְׁלֵמוּת הַדִּבּוּר – עַל יְדֵי אֱמֶת

additions.reason: Supporters of Torah — those who give money to support Torah scholars. Their act is a bechina of הולדה (birth) — they temporarily 'chill' their money (ירכות מצטננות = their resources diminish), which leads to the 'birth' of new halachot and the replenishment of their wealth.
additions.source_quote: יֵשׁ תַּמְכֵי אוֹרַיְתָא, שֶׁנּוֹתְנִים מָמוֹן לְלוֹמְדֵי תּוֹרָה

analysis_notes.summary: The dataset contains zero bechina edges from LM2 Torah 2. All 44 reference===2 bechina edges belong to LM1 Torah 2. LM2 Torah 2 has 5 distinct concept clusters (NEW_A through NEW_D plus the Chanukah synthesis cluster) that require a complete new data entry pass. The clusters are: (A) הלכות/הודאה/שעשוע עולם הבא/הולדה/תהלוכות הדמים — the Halakhah-as-Thanksgiving-as-Birth cluster; (B) אמת/דבור/ריבוע הדבור/לשון הקדש — the Truth-and-Speech cluster; (C) שבת/שמחה/אחדות הפשוט/מטטרון/עצבות — the Shabbat-vs-Weekdays cluster; (D) שמן/אור האמת/נר חנוכה/חנוכה — the Chanukah synthesis cluster binding all themes together.
